import * as echarts from 'echarts'

export const meta = {
  title: 'Live prices',
  kind: 'chart',
}

export function mount(el, ctx) {
  const chart = echarts.init(el)
  fetch('https://example.com/prices.json')
    .then((response) => response.json())
    .then((prices) => chart.setOption({ series: [{ type: 'line', data: prices }] }))
  return () => chart.dispose()
}
